changes.comment: BREAKING: IMcpToolCallResult gains blocks (every content block converter-validated into McpContentBlock: text, resource_link, embedded resource, image, audio, unknown) and structuredContent; callMcpTool takes IMcpCallToolOptions with includeMediaData. The text projection changes value: a resource_link now projects to `[resource_link: <uri> (<name>)]` and an embedded text resource to its text; an unknown or malformed block no longer fails the call, and an embedded resource's uri or a media block's mimeType that is missing or invalid is dropped rather than costing the block its body (personaility#675)
